name: hex
description: Internal data access primitive. Executes a Hex query and returns structured results. Called by core skills — not intended for direct use. Invoke when you need to run a Hex query on behalf of a core skill that has provided a query and pattern. Do not use for Sentry product telemetry, Sentry feature-usage questions, or explicit requests to use Sentry telemetry when the Sentry skill is available.
